survey: A folding camp chair, rendered in 3D, standing on a cream floor in front of an orange-red wall. The camera is a little above seat height and looks at the chair's front-left three-quarter side, so the floor recedes to the upper right. The green backrest is a flat panel stretched between two upright metal posts, with a rolled top tube and a yellow emblem. It faces the camera at a mild angle, and its right edge is nearer than its left. The green seat sling hangs between two side tubes that have end caps. Its front roll is foreshortened and runs parallel to the backrest top and to the floor rails. Each side has an X-shaped pair of legs pinned at a hinge. On the right side, the back post bends and continues down as one leg of the X. On the left side, the matching leg is hidden behind the seat. The four feet have rounded caps and are joined by a front floor rail and a back floor rail. Those rails run roughly parallel to the wall-floor line, which slopes down to the right, and they recede toward the same vanishing point as the seat and backrest edges. All four foot caps rest on the floor plane, and the soft shadow falls on that plane in a way that agrees with the view. The upright posts stay close to vertical. The round end caps on the seat tubes are ellipses that match the side-on view of those tubes.
